title: Oxygen Saturation
text: Oxygen saturation represents the proportion of hemoglobin binding sites occupied by oxygen. It is commonly estimated using pulse oximetry and is expressed as a percentage.

title: Kidney Function
text: The kidneys filter blood, remove metabolic waste, regulate fluid and electrolyte balance, contribute to acid-base regulation, and produce hormones involved in blood pressure regulation and red blood cell production.

title: DNA
text: DNA stores genetic information and provides instructions used for the development, function, and reproduction of living organisms.

title: Hypertension
text: Hypertension is persistently elevated blood pressure. Long-term hypertension increases the risk of cardiovascular, kidney, and cerebrovascular disease.

title: Hemoglobin
text: Hemoglobin is a protein in red blood cells that primarily transports oxygen from the lungs to tissues and carries some carbon dioxide back toward the lungs.

title: Insulin
text: Insulin is a hormone produced by pancreatic beta cells. It helps regulate blood glucose by promoting glucose uptake and storage and reducing hepatic glucose production.
